title: 第12章 龙象兽第13章 前夕
lines: 火焰熊熊燃烧着，偶尔会有一阵阵的白色雾气从丹炉中冒出，去除掉灵草中多余的杂质。
江玄眼神专注，不敢有丝毫的懈怠，虽然他拥有着至尊龙帝的记忆，但这毕竟是他第一次炼制，在手法上依旧会有些生疏。
当下，他急忙释放精神感知力，借助着精神感知力，江玄透过丹炉，看清了丹炉中变化，他小心翼翼的控制着丹炉上火焰的温度，使其达到一个平衡状态。
丹药的炼制过程繁杂且时间漫长，如此过去了许久，只见丹炉上方弥漫着一股金色的雾气。
“快成了！”
江玄眼神一亮，手上火焰的力量再度加强！在炼制丹药的过程中，火焰的掌控是炼制丹药最为关键的步骤，因为它直接决定了丹炉中的药材能否融合，所以江玄在这一刻可不敢有半点马虎，生怕一个不小心便会炸炉。
而在江玄这般小心翼翼的炼制下，房间之内的丹香也是越来越浓。
如此又过去了半个时辰，丹炉中再次传来了一阵嗡鸣，江玄眼眸微亮，手掌一招，丹炉之中的丹药顿时飞射而出，落到了江玄的手中。
看着手中那颗圆滚滚的丹药，江玄颇为满意的点了点头。
之后，江玄又开始炼制起了符，不过相比较于丹药，江玄炼制符速度就要大大提升了不少。
第二天，江玄一大早便将六阳融雪丹交给了灵儿。
随后，他便直接来到了百宝堂。
在百宝堂的后台，陆鸿看着桌上摆满的聚灵符，眼角不由得有些抽搐。
“这这些全都是聚灵符。”
他的眼神充满了震惊，要知道即便是元武皇朝最厉害的符师炼制一枚聚灵符也需要三天的时间，但这小子才多久？
然而就在这时，陆鸿像是发现了新大陆一般，眼眸顿时亮了。
他拿起一块泛着银色光芒的符，颇为好奇的问道。
“这是”“这是空间符！”
“空间符？”
陆鸿皱了皱眉，显然是第一次听说过这样一道符。
江玄点了点头。
“堂主应该知道到了化海境这一境界的强者便可以御空飞行，而到了元丹境的强者更是能够撕裂空间，一步之间，跨越千里而行！”
说到这，陆鸿的眼中带着一抹向往，那可是元丹境的强者啊！在这天水郡中最强的也不过真元境，对于他们来说，元丹境便是传说之中的存在，想要一步千里，谈何容易啊！“而这空间符便拥有着空间之力，能够瞬息间将人传送到千里之外！”
江玄摇了摇头，这元武皇朝实在是太过的落后，竟然连空间符都没有听说过，在江玄记忆中，这在神龙前辈所在的大陆中，这就是最低级的一道符。
“什么？”
然而，平淡的语气落到陆鸿的耳中，却如同惊雷一般炸响，他还是第一次听说过能够将人瞬间穿越千里的符。
“江玄，这符你还有吗？”
陆鸿顿时变得激动了起来，他知道这种东西如果一旦放出风声，会有多少人为之趋之若鹜，这可是一笔大买卖。
content_en:
"Buzz!"
The flames were burning brightly, and occasionally bursts of white mist would emerge from the alchemy furnace to remove excess impurities from the spiritual grass.
Jiang Xuan's eyes were focused and he didn't dare to slack off at all. Although he had the memory of the Supreme Dragon Emperor, this was his first time refining it, so his technique was still a bit unfamiliar.
At the moment, he hurriedly released his mental perception. With the help of his mental perception, Jiang Xuan could clearly see the changes in the alchemy furnace through the alchemy furnace. He carefully controlled the temperature of the flame on the alchemy furnace to achieve a balanced state.
The refining process of the elixir is complicated and takes a long time. After a long time, a golden mist was seen above the elixir furnace.
"It's almost done!"
Jiang Xuan's eyes lit up, and the power of the flame in his hand strengthened again! In the process of refining elixirs, the control of flame is the most critical step in refining elixirs, because it directly determines whether the medicinal materials in the elixir furnace can be fused, so Jiang Xuan did not dare to be careless at this moment, for fear that the furnace would explode if he was not careful.
And with Jiang Xuan's careful refining, the fragrance of the elixir in the room became stronger and stronger.
Another half hour passed in this way, and there was another buzzing sound in the alchemy furnace. Jiang Xuan's eyes lit up slightly, and with a move of his hand, the elixir in the alchemy furnace flew out and fell into Jiang Xuan's hand.
Looking at the round pill in his hand, Jiang Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
After that, Jiang Xuan began to refine the talisman again, but compared to the elixir, Jiang Xuan's refining talisman was much faster.
The next day, Jiang Xuan handed Liuyang Snow Melting Pill to Ling'er early in the morning.
Afterwards, he went directly to Baibao Hall.
Backstage at Baibao Hall, Lu Hong looked at the soul-gathering talismans on the table, and the corners of his eyes couldn't help but twitch.
"These are all soul-gathering talismans."
His eyes were full of shock. You must know that it would take three days for even the most powerful talisman master of the Yuanwu Dynasty to refine a spirit-gathering talisman, but how long does this kid only have?
"Eh!"
However, at this moment, Lu Hong's eyes suddenly lit up as if he had discovered a new world.
He picked up a talisman glowing with silver light and asked curiously.
"This is" "This is the space talisman!"
"Space Talisman?"
Lu Hong frowned. It was obviously the first time he had heard of such a talisman.
"Yeah!"
Jiang Xuan nodded.
"The hall master should know that a strong person who has reached the realm of sea transformation can fly in the air, and a strong person who has reached the Yuan Dan realm can even tear apart space and travel thousands of miles in one step!"
Speaking of this, Lu Hong's eyes were full of yearning, that was a strong man in the Yuan Dan realm! The strongest person in Tianshui County is only the True Yuan Realm. For them, the Yuan Dan Realm is a legendary existence. It is not easy to reach a thousand miles in one step! "And this space talisman possesses the power of space and can teleport people thousands of miles away in an instant!"
Jiang Xuan shook his head. The Yuanwu Dynasty was so backward that they had never even heard of the Space Talisman. In Jiang Xuan's memory, this was the lowest level talisman in the continent where Senior Shenlong lived.
"What?"
However, when the plain tone fell into Lu Hong's ears, it exploded like thunder. This was the first time he had heard of a talisman that could instantly travel thousands of miles.
"Jiang Xuan, do you still have this talisman?"
Lu Hong suddenly became excited. He knew how many people would flock to this kind of thing if word got out about it. This was a big deal.
